sections.Profile:
The "Mademoiselle" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1959, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, six pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, and a bullseye target.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
